scripts.type-check: pnpm -r --filter='./apps/**' run type-check && pnpm -r --filter='./packages/shared-types' run type-check
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && pnpm prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/database && pnpm prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd packages/database && pnpm prisma migrate reset --force
